sentences.en: Pronto Uomo White Stripe Fitted Dress Shirt is a twist to the classic white shirt found in almost every closet.

sentences.en: Finally, you could pick up a men's fashion magazine in the bookstore or the grocery store line to glean information about the pieces you absolutely must add to your wardrobe, pronto.

sentences.en: And that means it's time to find yourself some sexy sandals--pronto!

sentences.en: While this is an older and more conservative style than Gucci, there are the occasional shirts that fit into the hipper crowd, such as the Pronto line.
